integrity.proof: Finite-rank Laplacian inverse update, exhaustive signed-current classification, explicit orbit inequalities and strict final-step differences.
integrity.reproducibility: check.py is standalone and uses exact fractions; 39 finite graphs checked, not an infinite certificate.

scientific_limitations: Only balanced complete bipartite graphs with disjoint matching deletions and unit edge conductances.
Only canonical Euclidean-orthogonal cut/cycle projections in real edge ℓ1 and ℓ∞, not arbitrary projection minima or intermediate ℓp.
The novelty comparison is based on accessible primary texts, research searches and prior statements; undiscovered covering literature remains possible.
title: The matching-saturation jump and extremizer restoration for balanced bipartite cut–cycle projections
